externalEntryPoints.function: dispatch(address minter, uint256 amount, bytes extraData)
externalEntryPoints.flow: calls _dispatch(minter, amount, extraData) THEN hook.onDispatch(minter, amount, extraData)
stateChanges: none in this dispatcher's _dispatch (it is view/no-op)
externalEntryPoints.tokenMovement: NONE — USDC is HELD on this contract; not forwarded
transfers `amount` USDC from this contract to batchMinter; reverts via SafeERC20 if amount > held balance

externalEntryPoints.tokenMovement: owner can withdraw ANY ERC20 including held _token (USDC) backing accrued debt — accepted owner power, NatSpec-documented, NOT pause-gated

guards: NONE on releaser address (zero allowed, cosmetic)

externalCalls.notes: Standard 6-decimal USDC, deploy-time decimals()==6 guard. No balanceOf read in _dispatch (unlike sibling NudgeRatchet which sweeps full balance).
Owner sets via setHook. Guard forces it to be a real NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook (hookTypeId match) or dispatch reverts. Hook is where mint-debt + 1e12 scaling happens.
Only receives tokens; no callback invoked

baseInteraction.quote: function dispatch(...) external nonReentrant onlyMinter whenNotPaused { _dispatch(minter, amount, extraData); hook.onDispatch(minter, amount, extraData); }
baseInteraction.ordering: _dispatch runs FIRST (this variant: view no-op that only asserts the hook-type guard and HOLDS the USDC), THEN hook.onDispatch accrues phUSD mint-debt against `amount`. Mint-debt therefore accrues at dispatch time regardless of whether USDC has been released.
baseInteraction.hookStorage: IDispatchHook public hook — declared in base; constructor seeds it to new DefaultDispatchHook(); owner repoints via setHook (rejects zero). Never zero-address so dispatch path is branch-free, but DefaultDispatchHook would REVERT this dispatcher's hookTypeId guard, so owner must set the real hook before dispatching.

diffVsSiblingNudgeRatchet.siblingDispatchBehavior: NudgeRatchet._dispatch (non-view) reads bal = IERC20(_token).balanceOf(address(this)), require(bal >= amount), then IERC20(_token).safeTransfer(batchMinter, bal) — sweeps the FULL balance to batchMinter immediately on every dispatch.
diffVsSiblingNudgeRatchet.thisDispatchBehavior: NudgeRatchetDelayRelease._dispatch (view) only asserts the hookTypeId guard and performs NO transfer — USDC is HELD on the contract.
behavioralDeltas: USDC custody: sibling forwards immediately in _dispatch; this HOLDS USDC until a releaser calls release(amount).
_dispatch mutability: sibling is non-view (state/token mutation); this is `view` (no transfer, no balanceOf read).
New release path: this adds release(uint256) gated by onlyReleaser + nonReentrant, transferring a CALLER-SPECIFIED amount to batchMinter (sibling has no such function).
New access surface: this adds `releasers` mapping + setReleaser(addr,bool) onlyOwner + onlyReleaser modifier; sibling has none.
Rescue hatch: this adds rescueERC20(token,to,amount) onlyOwner (can withdraw held _token); sibling deliberately OMITS rescueERC20 because its full-balance sweep is self-cleaning.

Balance vs amount semantics: sibling transfers the full balance (>= amount, surplus = over-backing) and has a defensive `bal >= amount` require; this transfers neither — release moves an arbitrary admin-chosen amount independent of any single dispatch's `amount`.

Backing location invariant: sibling guarantees USDC reaches batchMinter same-tx as debt accrual; this introduces an intended, admin-controlled window where debt is accrued (and phUSD may be pulled) while USDC still sits on the dispatcher.
Events: this adds ReleaserUpdated + Released; both share BatchMinterUpdated + setBatchMinter.
unchangedAcrossBoth: EXPECTED_HOOK_TYPE_ID literal and the hookTypeId guard in _dispatch (identical).
Constructor signature (token_, batchMinter_, initialOwner) + 6-decimal USDC deploy guard + non-zero batchMinter guard.
Base dispatch flow: _dispatch then hook.onDispatch; mint-debt accrual against `amount` is identical.
Decimal scaling lives in the hook, not the dispatcher — neither dispatcher scales.

decimalScalingPath.scalingInThisDispatcher: NONE — NudgeRatchetDelayRelease performs no arithmetic and no decimal normalization. _dispatch is a view no-op (guard only).
decimalScalingPath.hookLine_constant: uint256 internal constant USDC_TO_PHUSD_SCALE = 1e12;  // 10**(18-6) for 6-dp USDC -> 18-dp phUSD
decimalScalingPath.hookLine_application: uint256 added = (amount * USDC_TO_PHUSD_SCALE * ratio) / 100;  // multiply-then-divide, floors, never over-credits
decimalScalingPath.m03Relevance: M-03 (decimal 1e12x under-mint / sign-flip trap) is contained entirely in the hook. This dispatcher cannot affect the scale direction or magnitude — it merely passes the unscaled 6-dp `amount` through the base into hook.onDispatch. Scaling is correct (up by 1e12) and unchanged from the NudgeRatchet path already audited.

hookTypeGuard.hookTypeIdReturn: function hookTypeId() external pure returns (bytes32) { return HOOK_TYPE_ID; }
hookTypeGuard.m04Q07Q08Relevance: M-04 guard is present and identical to the sibling NudgeRatchet. The DefaultDispatchHook seeded by the base constructor lacks hookTypeId() and would revert here, so dispatching is impossible until the owner setHook()s the real NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook. This satisfies the Q-07/Q-08 watch-note class (a no-op/wrong hook silently skipping mint-debt accrual) — it reverts loudly instead.

trustAssumptions: Owner is trusted and non-malicious (Law 3). setBatchMinter, setHook, setMinter, setReleaser, rescueERC20, setMetadata are owner powers.
_token is standard 6-decimal USDC (enforced at deploy); no fee-on-transfer / hooks assumed.
The configured hook is a real NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook (enforced via hookTypeId guard each dispatch).

_minter (NFTMinterV2) is trusted to only call dispatch with an `amount` matching the USDC actually deposited — this dispatcher, unlike the sibling, does NOT re-assert balance >= amount (it holds rather than sweeps), so it relies on the minter for that invariant.
Releasers are owner-curated; release rate (and thus the debt-accrued-vs-USDC-released window) is an intentional admin lever.
rescueERC20 over _token can leave accrued mint-debt under-backed — explicitly an accepted owner responsibility per NatSpec.
anomaliesObserved: release(amount) takes a caller-specified amount and is the ONLY path that moves held USDC out — unlike the sibling's automatic full-balance sweep. The intended decoupling means debt can be accrued and phUSD pulled (via hook.pull) while USDC remains held; the contract's own NatSpec marks this as accepted design (rate-controlled release), not an accounting bug. Flagged as FACT for downstream interaction/econ review, not classified here.

rescueERC20 can withdraw held _token (USDC backing accrued debt) and is NOT pause-gated. Owner-power, NatSpec-acknowledged. Surface for downstream owner-footgun consideration (Law 3), not classified here.
setReleaser does not reject the zero address and setMinter (base) does not reject zero — cosmetic, owner-only, no exploit surface.

_dispatch is `view` and performs no balance check; correctness of mint-debt backing depends on the NFTMinterV2 caller depositing >= amount before dispatch (the sibling's defensive `bal >= amount` require is absent because nothing is transferred here). FACT for interaction analysis.
No nonReentrant on rescueERC20 (owner-only single transfer; low concern).
